seo.title: Laboratories
seo.description: The laboratory areas of the Veterinary Research Institute: diagnostics, testing and specialised technical support.

hero.title: The IIV laboratories
hero.lead: Nine specialised areas cover veterinary diagnostics, food safety and epidemiological surveillance in Angola.

cta.title: Need to request a test?
cta.lead: Check our services or contact us directly to find out what samples and documentation to prepare.

parasitologia.name: Parasitology
parasitologia.short: Diagnosis of parasitic diseases in livestock.
parasitologia.description: Diagnosis of haemoparasitic and endoparasitic diseases in domestic and production animals, using reference microscopy techniques.

bacteriologia.name: General Bacteriology
bacteriologia.short: Isolation and identification of bacterial agents.
bacteriologia.description: Isolation and identification of bacterial agents of animal origin, including antibiograms and antimicrobial resistance surveillance — one of the institute's highest-volume areas.

serologia.name: Serology
serologia.short: Detection of antibodies and immune response.
serologia.description: Detection of antibodies and immunological markers by ELISA, SAT and AGID, with continuous cold-chain monitoring of reagents and equipment.

biologia-molecular.name: Molecular Biology
biologia-molecular.description: Nucleic acid extraction and quantification, PCR and support for genetic sequencing to detect and characterise pathogenic agents at the molecular level.

bromatologia.name: Food Science (Bromatology)
bromatologia.description: Physicochemical and microbiological analysis of animal feed and raw materials, with strict quality criteria before any batch is released.

microbiologia-alimentar.name: Food Microbiology
microbiologia-alimentar.short: Microbiological safety of water and animal-origin food.
microbiologia-alimentar.description: Microbiological control of water and animal-origin food, with support for on-site sample collection.

raiva.name: Rabies
raiva.short: Rabies diagnosis and epidemiological surveillance support.
raiva.description: Laboratory diagnosis of rabies by direct and indirect immunofluorescence, with inter-laboratory referral and mandatory notification to the veterinary health authority given the disease's zoonotic nature.

lavagem-esterilizacao.name: Washing, Sterilisation and Culture Media
lavagem-esterilizacao.short: Cross-cutting support for all laboratory areas.
lavagem-esterilizacao.description: Cross-cutting support area responsible for preparing culture media, sterilisation cycles for equipment, and reagent batch management for all other laboratory areas.

sala-incubacao.name: Incubation Room
sala-incubacao.short: Cross-cutting support for nearly every laboratory area.
sala-incubacao.description: One of the laboratory's operational backbones: controls incubation of samples and cultures used by nearly every area, with continuous temperature monitoring.
techniques: Controlled incubation of samples and cultures
